claims.claim: Vancouver is auctioning 116 properties Wednesday at city hall starting at 10 a.m. in a tax sale of properties with three years of unpaid taxes, with the reserve set at the amount owed.
claims.episode_span: the City of Vancouver auctions 116 properties at city hall on Wednesday, starting at 10 a.m.
claims.source_title: This $1.7M Vancouver home has an auction reserve of $72K. Yes, there’s a catch
claims.supporting_quote: The property is among 116 properties listed for auction by the City of Vancouver in this year’s tax sale, in which properties whose owners have not paid their taxes for three years are auctioned off, with the reserve, or upset price, set at the amount owed to the city.

claims.claim: A Windsor Street house in East Vancouver assessed at more than $1.7 million has a tax-auction reserve of $72,051.
claims.episode_span: A Windsor Street house in East Vancouver, assessed by BC Assessment at more than $1.7 million, has a reserve of $72,051.
claims.source_title: This $1.7M Vancouver home has an auction reserve of $72K. Yes, there’s a catch
claims.supporting_quote: But with an official BC Assessment valuation of more than $1.7 million, the house could represent a bargain when it goes up for sale at Vancouver’s annual tax auction at city hall on Wednesday with a reserve price of just $72,051.

claims.claim: Two Point Grey Road houses valued around $5 million and $6 million have upset prices of about $289,000 and $355,000.
claims.episode_span: Two side-by-side houses on Point Grey Road, valued around $5 million and $6 million, have upset prices of about $289,000 and $355,000.
claims.source_title: This $1.7M Vancouver home has an auction reserve of $72K. Yes, there’s a catch
claims.supporting_quote: A few blocks down the road from Wilson are two side-by-side houses valued around $5 million and $6 million.

claims.claim: Owners have one year after the auction to redeem by paying taxes, refunding the bidder plus interest, and the highest bidders must pay the upset price by noon Thursday.
claims.episode_span: After auction day the current owners have a year to redeem by paying their taxes, which refunds the bidder plus interest.
claims.source_title: This $1.7M Vancouver home has an auction reserve of $72K. Yes, there’s a catch
claims.supporting_quote: After auction day, the current owners have a year to redeem their property by paying their taxes, resulting in a refund to the bidder, plus interest.

claims.claim: The City of Vancouver said only three properties changed hands from a tax sale in the last 10 years.
claims.episode_span: The city said there were only three instances in the last 10 years where a property changed hands from a tax sale
claims.source_title: This $1.7M Vancouver home has an auction reserve of $72K. Yes, there’s a catch
claims.supporting_quote: the City of Vancouver said in a statement that there “were only three instances in the last 10 years where a property changed hands from a tax sale.”
